Manish Todi Appreciate your question. But its better you reach out to the some
students of previous batch, ask them for sample content and review it yourself
!! And also have detailed discussion with sales representative Some key
parameters to look for in any course are :1. How much live , how much recorded
content. If recorded - can you really sit and listen to recordings ?2. How
much % is hands on, does it suit your current level of expertise and who , how
doubts are answered 3\. How many capstone/projects are there ? Ask for
previous capstone projects done - not just names, reports as well. 4\. How
much personalized the course is ? Like do you get to talk with any tech mentor
who will design path and give feedback for you ? 5\. How accessible is the
tech people who teach you? 6\. If any policy like placement assistance is
mentioned - what exactly is it - only resume review or your resume will be
forwarded to other companies ? If you get recruiters access - how much approx
? 7\. If you are getting certificate with any institute name - how much is it
appreciated in the industry ? 8\. More importantly, refund policy and feedback
handling Decide for yourself. Don't regret later
